NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DEVISERA uses the microphone so you can dictate the description of your job.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: DEVISERA transcribes your job description to prepare the quote for you.
NSCameraUsageDescription: DEVISERA uses the camera for your profile photo and job-site photos.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DEVISERA accesses the photos you choose for your profile and your quotes.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: DEVISERA protects your session with Face ID so your quotes and clients stay private.
NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: DEVISERA notifies you when a client views a quote or a follow-up is ready.
